text: DSH Model Interruption Notifier 在模型运行以错误结束时记录失败状态，并可在会话空闲后自动提交“继续”，也可在网页右下角显示提醒供用户确认。它通过 DSH Session 投影保存最新失败信息，排除委派子 agent；提醒提供稍后、关闭和确认继续操作，并在插件详情页提供自动继续开关。适合希望失败后续跑或手动检查后再续接 DSH 会话的用户。自动继续默认开启，使用现有会话模型与上下文。

DSH Model Interruption Notifier records failed model turns. It either submits “继续” after the session becomes idle or shows a reminder where users can defer, dismiss, or resume. A detail-page switch controls automatic continuation, using the existing model and conversation context.
DSH 模型运行报错后能不能自动发消息接着跑？
我想先看到失败提醒，再决定要不要继续当前会话。
Can a failed DSH model turn resume automatically when the session becomes idle?
DSH Model Interruption Notifier 的功能「失败后自动继续」：检测会话中以错误结束的模型轮次，并在会话空闲且失败仍为最新状态时，通过原会话提交“继续”。
DSH Model Interruption Notifier 的功能「失败提醒与手动续接」：网页右下角展示失败会话和错误摘要，用户可稍后处理或确认发送“继续”；提交前会检查会话状态。
DSH Model Interruption Notifier 使用前须知：续接会通过原会话的模型提供方和上下文发起常规推理；错误信息也会显示在提醒中。（见 docs/guide.md:35-37）

dsh-model-interruption-notifier README · DSH Model Interruption Notifier：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Continue a DSH conversation after a failed model run, automatically or after confirmation in a corner reminder. Automatic continuation is enabled by default and submits the exact text `继续` through the original conversation's normal prompt path.

The plugin also provides a live switch in its detail page. It follows the DSH theme and excludes delegated subagents.

The plugin uses DSH extension services and ships no game logic, company integrations, account configuration, or conversation data. Continuing a conversation uses its existing model provider and context; the plugin adds no separate reporting endpoint.
